# Checkpoint and scope-proof golden vectors, v1 (bead fa-l3c). Pinned;
# never regenerated to make a change pass: a format change is a new v2 file.
# Producer: crates/fa-notary/tests/golden.rs signs a TransparencyCheckpoint
# over the 4-leaf state of accumulator_v1.txt (book 0x5a.., through seq 6)
# with the Ed25519 key of seed 0x11 x 32 and a fixed substrate chain
# commitment 0xc0 x 32 (the synthetic journal has no substrate), and proves
# three scopes of its 5-tuple scope index; it must reproduce these bytes.
# Verifier: crates/fa-verify/tests/golden.rs verifies them with nothing but
# fa-verify. The Ed25519 scheme itself is pinned separately to RFC 8032 §7.1.
# Lines are `<name> <lowercase hex>`:
#   public_key   the signer's public key
#   checkpoint   the signed checkpoint
#   scope        rent (0x10), day 20527: the run at the start of the index
#   scope_empty  fx (0x20), days 20528..=20600: an empty run between neighbours
#   scope_last   cash (0x30), every day: the run at the end of the index
